tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Fresh original reusable children's educational character poses, directly based on sole attached adopted Moose identity/style reference, not a pixel edit. Preserve this exact character's colours and asymmetric colour patches, short bipedal character anatomy, head/trunk/ear/tail proportions and warm brown contour/paint texture. Preserve original exact white eyes with plain brown pupils, no white sparkle highlights. Keep existing forepaw/toe designs and counts, not extra human fingers. No new pale palms, pads or claws; retain original reference paw colours. Same head and full standing torso proportions in all poses. Do not make a squat/smaller redesign.
Composition: single complete full-body character on transparent1254x1254 canvas, original adopted figure placement and size. Keep exact adopted standing head/torso/foot position; the only change is the specified pose.
1. species_b — Ears settle toward their neutral angle as the head starts returning; preserve the same body size and foot support.
Constraints: genuine transparency with generated alpha, no ground, shadows, text, labels, grid, symbols, effect rays, sparkles or ANY added objects. Do not add mouth opening, tongue or tooth changes; original closed friendly mouth. No new clothes, highlights, limbs, pads or disconnected parts. Crisp native contours and clean soft painted paper surfaces, no messy lumps, bleeding or blur. This character is required at its existing large use size, so prioritize native figure resolution rather than small drawings in empty cells.
